items.label: Validity period
items.value: Exchange validity period of 60 days (no extension)

items.label: Cancellation and refund
items.value: Full refund available within the validity period if unused

sections.title: How to use
sections.description:
[CU stores]
Present the mobile gift card barcode when paying
(Can be used just like cash or a card at CU stores nationwide)

sections.title: Usage information
sections.description:
It can be used just like cash or a card at CU stores nationwide.
It can be combined with cash, a card, or other payment methods.
Mobile carrier discount cards can be applied.
CU mobile gift cards support balance tracking and can be used in installments within the remaining balance.
A cash receipt can be issued.
For balance and usage history inquiries: Galaxia Communications customer center, 1566-0123

sections.title: Changes and cancellation
sections.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.

sections.title: Precautions
sections.description:
The exchange validity period is 60 days.
It cannot be combined with other coupons, and points cannot be earned.
Restricted items: cigarettes, lottery tickets, garbage bags, T-money top-ups, parcel delivery, and other service products
